ideas.pitch: A machine learning platform built for university professors and administrators at Chandigarh University to forecast student attendance drops and academic failure risks using historical engagement metrics and Poisson regression.
ideas.title: CampusPulse AI: Student Attendance & Academic Risk Predictor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeting campus administration and real operational metrics appeals directly to the judges from Google Developer Groups on Campus who value practical utilities for academic environments.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered nutrition platform tailored for hostel messes to analyze daily meal menus, predict student nutritional deficiencies, and optimize bulk ordering using personalized Gemini API health insights.
ideas.title: Mess-O-Meter: Smart Campus Dietary and Nutritional Optimizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves an immediate, relatable campus-wide problem at Chandigarh University hostels while demonstrating rapid implementation of Google's Gemini API within a 24-hour window.

ideas.pitch: A multi-agent sustainability platform utilizing LangGraph and RAG to audit university building energy consumption, track waste disposal compliance, and generate automated sustainability reports for campus facilities.
ideas.title: EcoCampus AI: Multi-Agent Energy Audit & Waste Monitoring System
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines a trendy multi-agent architecture with a high-impact institutional use case that resonates strongly with university sustainability initiatives and technical judges.

ideas.pitch: An interactive mapping platform for university estate management that leverages satellite imagery and GIS data to monitor unauthorized construction or land encroachment across Chandigarh University's expansive campus.
ideas.title: CU-SafeGuard: Campus Geofenced Asset & Land Compliance Tracker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Brings geospatial intelligence to an institutional setting, providing a visually striking demo that easily commands judge attention during a fast-paced offline pitching session.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous discovery engine that indexes faculty and student research papers across different departments at Chandigarh University to automatically suggest interdisciplinary collaboration projects and funding opportunities.
ideas.title: PeerSync: Inter-Departmental Research Collaboration & Grant Matcher
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly aligns with the hackathon's explicit encouragement of interdisciplinary and inter-specialization team formation among university students.
